messages:
olivia: Ran the nightly perf job on mixtral-8 converted from HF safetensors — saw a 2.3x token latency spike starting around token ~500. Attaching quick profiler summary. Has anyone seen conversion metadata causing kernel fallbacks?

sam: I ran a quick inspect — a few of the uploaded safetensors are missing explicit rope/rope_scaling metadata and some have kv shape fields that don't line up with num_attention_heads. When those are missing we fall back to the generic attention kernel.

dani: Converter printed this warning during conversion: "warning: metadata.heads=64, metadata.kv_dim=512 but expected kv_dim=heads*(head_dim)" — pasted HF config excerpt below:
```
{
  "model": {
    "hidden_size": 4096,
    "num_attention_heads": 64,
    "kv_channels": 64
  }
}
```

perf-bot: profiling summary: avg token latency baseline 43ms -> spike window avg 98ms. KV cache miss rate jumped from 11% -> 46% during the spike. Kernel fallback count +932 in 3s window.

infra-bot: routing log: model=mixtral-8-safetensors routed to fallback kernel "fallback_attention_basic_v1" at 2026-09-12T02:14:23Z because kernel ABI compatibility check failed.

sam: Root cause hypothesis: missing rope_scaling and inconsistent kv metadata triggers two things: (1) our optimized rotary kernels (which require explicit scaling/base metadata) are disabled, (2) converter writes a compact KV layout that the optimized KV cache path doesn't expect -> increases mem copies and breaks batching alignment.

mike (eng-runtime): Proposed actions: 1) patch hf-convert to heuristically inject reasonable rope_scaling/rope_base when absent (log and increment a metric), 2) add a strict sanity check in onboarding that rejects safetensors lacking metadata.rope_scaling or metadata.kv_shape (fail-fast), and 3) temporarily bias kernel selector to prefer "generic_attention_v2" over heavy fallback for this model family until we verify layout parity. Who can run an AB with the patched converter?

olivia: I'll run the AB against the failing checkpoint with seq=2048 and batch=1. Quick reproducer: 
```
python tools/perf_repro.py --model /mnt/models/mixtral8.safetensors --seq 2048 --batch 1 --emit-traces
```

sam: Also adding a micro sanity check script that compares expected_kv = num_attention_heads * per_head_kv (derived) vs metadata.kv_dim and emits a non-zero exit code if mismatch. We should run it on all recent uploads. I'll open a PR for hf-convert to run that check during conversion.

dani: Filed GH issue #1427 with logs and attached the failing safetensors metadata dump. Assigned @sam for hf-convert and @mike for kernel selector routing change.

perf-bot: scheduled: perf-repro run by @olivia in ~10m. Metric alerts created for KV-mismatch-rate and kernel-fallback-rate.

mike (eng-runtime): After the AB, if perf looks stable, we should add a non-destructive fixer that injects metadata into existing uploads with owner consent. For now, reject by default to avoid silent perf regressions.

olivia: Got it — starting the run and will paste results. Thanks y'all :thumbsup:
